articles.title: How DeFi is changing the financial landscape for Latin Americans
articles.snippet: DeFi is quietly shifting from niche crypto experiment to a legitimate financial tool across the region, explains Serrano.

articles.title: LayerZero says it ‘made a mistake’ in $292 Million Kelp exploit
articles.snippet: After initially framing the exploit as a developer configuration failure, LayerZero said it “owns” the decision to let its own verifier secure high-value transfers in a vulnerable setup.

articles.title: Judge clears path for Aave to move $71 million in ETH linked to North Korea hack
articles.snippet: Judge Margaret Garnett allowed frozen exploit funds on Arbitrum to move to Aave, but the legal freeze follows the assets as terrorism plaintiffs continue their claim.

articles.title: Why a 2017 Linux bug is now a major concern for the crypto industry
articles.snippet: The “Copy Fail” Linux bug could impact crypto infrastructure that relies on Linux servers, highlighting growing cybersecurity risks in the digital asset industry. Format: Explained

articles.title: Arbitrum DAO Votes to Unlock $70 Million for Kelp DAO Exploit Relief
articles.snippet: Arbitrum DAO voted to release the Kelp exploit funds, but a U.S. Court restraining notice has put the approved transfer in legal jeopardy.
